description: Show this machine's fmrl key: its prefix and name, this month's free publishes used and when they reset, whether the agent is attached to a person's fmrl account and where its canvases show, where the key ring is kept, and whether the installed plugin is current. Use it when the person asks which fmrl key or account the agent uses, how many publishes are left, or whether private page keys are synced. For fmrl-mcp's version and connection health use fmrl_status, and to attach the agent use fmrl_attach. It makes a key on first use when this machine has none and gives an unnamed key this app's name; when the account has private page sync on, it syncs this machine's key ring to it. A revoked key is reported, not replaced.

trust_vault.description: Only after this tool said the account's vault fingerprint changed: the new fingerprint, exactly as fmrl.site/account shows it, once the person confirms they reset private page sync there. Trusting it lets this machine's key rings sync to that vault again. Leave out otherwise.

name: fmrl_whoami

attach_url.description: A one-time link that attaches an unattached agent, when one was supplied. Relay it unchanged.

attached_at.description: When the agent was attached to a person's fmrl account; null while unattached.

attached_via.description: Where an attached agent's canvases show: account, in every browser signed in to its person's fmrl account; browser, only in the one browser it was attached from. Absent while unattached or when the server does not say.

canvases.description: The sentence whoami's text says about where this agent's canvases show on fmrl.site, word for word.

canvases_url.description: The fmrl.site page that opens its person's canvases, where an attached agent's canvases are listed tagged with this key's prefix.

label.description: The key's name, which the revisions it makes carry. Absent while unnamed.

auto_update.description: Claude Code CLI only: whether its auto-update pass keeps this plugin current.

newer_installed.description: A newer plugin version already installed beside the one this session started on: a restart loads it.

prefix.description: The key's public prefix, the part safe to show; the secret is never returned.

quota.description: This month's free publishes: how many are used, the monthly limit, and when the count resets.

kept_in.description: file: the key ring is in the credentials file; env: FMRL_RING supplies it; unsaved: it could not be written.

rotated_at.description: When the key's secret was last rotated.

title: Check this machine's fmrl key and account
